_stl_files: ASCII STL geometry files located in stl/ directory

flow._comment: Flow conditions: velocity in m/s (16.67 m/s is approx 60 km/h); ground=true enables moving road

outputs._comment: Axis projection: drag along flow (-z) and downforce towards ground (-y)

_domain_box: Wind tunnel bounds [x, y, z] in meters (min and max corners)
_domain_faces: Boundary types for the 6 outer box faces: inlet, outlet, ground, farField, symmetry

parallel._comment: Number of CPU cores for MPI decomposition, meshing, and solving

slurm._comment: SLURM cluster configuration for CU e-Science cluster
slurm._use_tmpdir: true = run in fast node scratch ($TMPDIR) with live sync; false = run in-place in case dir

overrides._comment: Optional expert overrides for snappyHexMesh and boundary layers

mesh_params._base_cell_size: Base blockMesh cell size in meters (0.10 m = 10 cm)
mesh_params._surface_level: [min, max] surface refinement: cell = base / (2^level) -> L4=6.25mm, L6=1.56mm
mesh_params._edge_level: Refinement on extracted sharp feature edges -> L6 = 1.56mm
mesh_params._resolveFeatureAngle: Curvature threshold angle: regions sharper than this get max surface level (deg)
mesh_params._distance_levels: Conforming refinement shells around STL: [[distance_in_meters, level], ...]

layers._comment: Boundary layer inflation prism cells for near-wall viscous resolution
layers._n_layers: Number of inflated prism layers grown off the wall
layers._expansion_ratio: Geometric growth ratio from one layer to the next (outer / inner)
layers._first_layer_thickness: Thickness of the first cell at the wall (relative to surface cell size)
layers._featureAngle: Corner angle threshold beyond which prism layers will not extrude around corners

feature_extract._includedAngle: Angle threshold for surfaceFeatureExtract to detect sharp edges from STL (deg)
